title: Illinois Paid Leave for All Workers Act
facts: Covered Illinois workers can earn up to 40 hours of paid leave per 12-month period.
Accrual is at least 1 hour of paid leave for every 40 hours worked.
Covered workers may use the leave for any reason and employers generally may not require a reason for the request.
Chicago and Cook County have separate local paid-leave rules; state PLAWA does not govern workers covered by those local ordinances.
